burnAndSwapForExactETH(address,uint256,b.details: Redeems up to `poolAmountInMax` pool tokens for the first token in `path` and swaps it to exactly `ethAmountOut` ether.

params.indexPool: Address of the index pool to burn tokens from.
params.path: Array of encoded tokens to swap using the Narwhal router.
params.poolAmountInMax: Maximum amount of pool tokens to burn.

burnAndSwapForExactTokens(address,uint25.details: Redeems up to `poolAmountInMax` pool tokens for the first token in `path` and swaps it to exactly `tokenAmountOut` of the last token in `path`.

params.indexPool: Address of the index pool to burn tokens from.
params.path: Array of encoded tokens to swap using the Narwhal router.
params.poolAmountInMax: Maximum amount of pool tokens to burn.
params.tokenAmountOut: Amount of last token in `path` to receive.

burnExactAndSwapForETH(address,uint256,b.details: Redeems `poolAmountIn` pool tokens for the first token in `path` and swaps it to at least `minAmountOut` ether.

params.indexPool: Address of the index pool to burn tokens from.
params.minAmountOut: Amount of ether that must be received to not revert.
params.path: Array of encoded tokens to swap using the Narwhal router.
params.poolAmountIn: Amount of pool tokens to burn.

burnExactAndSwapForTokens(address,uint25.details: Redeems `poolAmountIn` pool tokens for the first token in `path` and swaps it to at least `minAmountOut` of the last token in `path`.

params.indexPool: Address of the index pool to burn tokens from.
params.minAmountOut: Amount of last token in `path` that must be received to not revert.
params.path: Array of encoded tokens to swap using the Narwhal router.
params.poolAmountIn: Amount of pool tokens to burn.

burnForAllTokensAndSwapForETH(address,ui.details: Burns `poolAmountOut` for all the underlying tokens in a pool, then swaps each of them on Uniswap for at least `minAmountOut` ether. Up to one intermediary token may be provided in `intermediaries` for each underlying token in the index pool. If a null address is provided as an intermediary, the input token will be swapped directly for the output token.

params.indexPool: Address of the index pool to burn tokens from.
params.intermediaries: Encoded Narwhal tokens array with a one-byte prefix indicating whether the swap to the underlying token should use sushiswap.
params.minAmountOut: Minimum amount of ether that must be received to not revert.
params.minAmountsOut: Minimum amount of each underlying token that must be received from the pool to not revert.
params.poolAmountIn: Amount of index pool tokens to burn.

burnForAllTokensAndSwapForTokens(address.details: Burns `poolAmountOut` for all the underlying tokens in a pool, then swaps each of them on Uniswap for at least `minAmountOut` of `tokenOut`. Up to one intermediary token may be provided in `intermediaries` for each underlying token in the index pool. If a null address is provided as an intermediary, the input token will be swapped directly for the output token.

params.indexPool: Address of the index pool to burn tokens from.
params.intermediaries: Encoded Narwhal tokens array with a one-byte prefix indicating whether the swap to the underlying token should use sushiswap.
params.minAmountOut: Minimum amount of `tokenOut` that must be received to not revert.
params.minAmountsOut: Minimum amount of each underlying token that must be received from the pool to not revert.
params.poolAmountIn: Amount of index pool tokens to burn.
params.tokenOut: Address of the token to buy.

swapETHForAllTokensAndMintExact(address,.details: Swaps ether for every underlying token in an index pool, then mints `poolAmountOut` pool tokens from the pool. Up to one intermediary token may be provided in `intermediaries` for each underlying token in the index pool. If a null address is provided as an intermediary, the input token will be swapped directly for the output token. `intermediaries` is an encoded Narwhal path with a one-byte prefix indicating whether the first swap should use sushiswap.

params.indexPool: Address of the index pool to mint tokens with.
params.intermediaries: Encoded Narwhal tokens array with a one-byte prefix indicating whether the swap to the underlying token should use sushiswap.
params.poolAmountOut: Amount of index pool tokens to mint.

swapETHForTokensAndMintExact(bytes32[],a.details: Swaps ether for each token in `path` through Uniswap, then mints `poolAmountOut` pool tokens from `indexPool`.

params.indexPool: Address of the index pool to mint tokens from.
params.path: Array of encoded tokens to swap using the Narwhal router.
params.poolAmountOut: Amount of pool tokens that must be received to not revert.

swapExactETHForTokensAndMint(bytes32[],a.details: Swaps ether for each token in `path` using their Uniswap pairs, then mints at least `minPoolAmountOut` pool tokens from `indexPool`.

params.indexPool: Address of the index pool to mint tokens from.
params.minPoolAmountOut: Amount of pool tokens that must be received to not revert.
params.path: Array of encoded tokens to swap using the Narwhal router.

swapExactTokensForTokensAndMint(uint256,.details: Swaps a token for each other token in `path` using their Uniswap pairs, then mints at least `minPoolAmountOut` pool tokens from `indexPool`.

params.amountIn: Amount of the first token in `path` to swap.
params.indexPool: Address of the index pool to mint tokens from.
params.minPoolAmountOut: Amount of pool tokens that must be received to not revert.
params.path: Array of encoded tokens to swap using the Narwhal router.

swapTokensForAllTokensAndMintExact(addre.details: Swaps an input token for every underlying token in an index pool, then mints `poolAmountOut` pool tokens from the pool. Up to one intermediary token may be provided in `intermediaries` for each underlying token in the index pool. If a null address is provided as an intermediary, the input token will be swapped directly for the output token. `intermediaries` is an encoded Narwhal path with a one-byte prefix indicating whether the first swap should use sushiswap.

params.indexPool: Address of the index pool to mint tokens with.
params.intermediaries: Encoded Narwhal tokens array with a one-byte prefix indicating whether the swap to the underlying token should use sushiswap.
params.poolAmountOut: Amount of index pool tokens to mint.
params.tokenIn: Token to buy the underlying tokens with.

swapTokensForTokensAndMintExact(uint256,.details: Swaps a token for each other token in `path` through Uniswap, then mints at least `poolAmountOut` pool tokens from `indexPool`.

params.amountInMax: Maximum amount of the first token in `path` to give.
params.indexPool: Address of the index pool to mint tokens from.
params.path: Array of encoded tokens to swap using the Narwhal router.
params.poolAmountOut: Amount of pool tokens that must be received to not revert.
